facts.fact: Per the Railways Citizen Charter, the refund amount is transferred within 7 working days to the account from which the ticket was booked
facts.quote: Within 7 working days amount is transferred and deposited in the account from which the ticket was booked.

summary: Confirmed on the Citizen Charter (TAG 2026) on ir.indianrailways.gov.in; the old indianrailways.gov.in/railwayboard URL now returns 404 after the site redesign.
